plans.note: Sections 9.1 and 9.2 set separate caps for IBM and Customer; check mutuality, cap size (fees paid), consequential damages exclusion and carve-outs (indemnity in 8.1, confidentiality, gross negligence). Section 5.4 Other Disclaimers may add further liability exclusions to review alongside.
IBM indemnity in 8.1 (test for third-party IP coverage and remedies); Customer indemnity in 8.2 must stay narrow; sec-1 appears to be the indemnity claim procedure (notice/control) applying to both.
No non-compete heading; 14.16 Freedom of Action typically preserves both parties' freedom (benefits us). Confirm 14.11 No Resale and 13.2 AUP do not restrict our business lines beyond resale.
Check 14.16 Freedom of Action and the services/charges provisions for any sole-source or exclusive-supplier language; likely none in this IBM hosting form.
Scan Charges for any best-pricing or most-favoured-customer undertaking running against us; direction rule — an MFN in our favour is acceptable and not flagged.
14.8 Personnel is the likely home for any hiring restriction; verify mutuality, duration (12 months or less) and a general-advertising/unsolicited-response carve-out.

3.4 governs convenience termination — check notice period, whether the right is mutual (IBM should not be able to exit mid-term) and any termination charges; 3.5 and 4.1 may impose exit fees or unwind costs.
3.2 Renewal: test for automatic renewal, length of renewal term, non-renewal notice window and any price uplift; 3.1 sets the initial term and 4.1 may govern renewal pricing.

14.3 Choice of Law is the operative clause (New York accepted). Note 14.4 jury waiver and 14.14 Actions Period (contractual limitations period) in the rationale; check whether any venue/arbitration term appears.
14.10 Assignment: confirm we may assign to affiliates and to a successor by merger or asset sale without consent, and that IBM cannot terminate on our change of control.

12.1 License and 14.17 Limitation of Licenses define IP allocation; 11.6 Content and Digital Certificates plus 14.18 Data Protection and 5.3 Security bear on ownership and handling of Customer content/data. Flag only if our content or data rights are assigned or licensed too broadly to IBM.
12.1 is the grant — check scope (affiliates and contractors as permitted users), revocability, and whether 14.17 narrows it; 13.1/12.2 describe the services and base components covered.

11.3 Suspected Violations is the likely inspection/monitoring hook against us; test for notice, frequency, off-site review and who bears cost. 13.2 AUP and 11.5 Capacity Planning may carry related monitoring rights.
Look for late-payment interest, early-termination charges or stipulated damages payable by us in 4.2 and 3.5; service credits running to us are welcome and not flagged.

5.1 contains IBM's warranties and 5.2/5.4 the disclaimers — assess whether a workmanlike-performance warranty with a real remedy survives the exclusivity-of-warranties language; 11.2 is Customer's reciprocal warranty and 12.2 covers maintenance of base components.
No insurance heading in the outline; check 5.3 Security, 14.12 Risk of Loss and 14.18 Data Protection before concluding the requirement is missing given IBM hosts our data.

4.1 Charges (with Order Forms/Service Option Attachments) and 11.5 Capacity Planning are where minimum volumes or committed capacity would sit; confirm any commitment pairs with the 3.4 convenience exit.

3.5 Effect of Termination is the natural home — check for return or deletion of Customer content, a defined retrieval window and any transition assistance; 14.18 and 11.6 address data handling, 14.2 survival.
